events.name: Bash
events.head: Find centre Worker Tantra admin routes
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls cloud/src | head -30; grep -rn "tantra" cloud/src/*.js cloud/src/**/*.js 2>/dev/null | grep -in "route\|path ===\|pathname\|/api/admin" | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find Tantra routes in centre index
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rn "tantra" cloud/src/index.ts | grep -i "path\|route\|/api" | head -30; grep -n "export\|accounts\|li_account\|email-account\|connected" cloud/src/jobs-tantra.ts | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how past runs reached Tantra via sealed key
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls workshop-plan/tasks/activity/ | grep -E "T-(234|228|337|034)"; for f in workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-228.json workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-234.json workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-034.json; do [ -f $f ] && grep -o '[^"]\{0,200\}\(tantra-proxy\|/admin/api[^"]\{0,80\}tantra\|tantra/accounts\|/api/tantra\)[^"]\{0,200\}' $f | head -5; done
